Meta.title: Elona Keys
Meta.author: Anon
Meta.description: Classic Elona keybinds for Elin. Play with the keyboard instead of the mouse: e to eat, q to quaff, r to read, Z to zap, g to get, d to drop, w to wear, v to cast, o to open, p to pray, i to interact and more, with Elona-style selection menus. All keys rebindable in BepInEx/config/elin.elonakeys.cfg or by using modconfig gui.
